name: Iron Renegade
look: a towering violet robot Giratina striped in black and yellow chevrons, with steel spikes up its neck, six spiked black legs, a golden mask and a jagged pink burst of energy flaring at its back
entry: A Pokémon resembling Giratina, recorded in a report about a machine that broke out of a dimension where it had been sealed away. Wild energy bursts from its back when it is angered.
how: Wild: very rare in the Nether's warped forests.
